entities.summary: Roger Jeffrey Miner was an American lawyer and judge. He was a United States circuit judge of the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit from 1985 until his death, and was previously a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Northern District of New York from 1981 to 1985. Before his time as a federal judge, he was a New York Supreme Court justice from 1976 to 1981, and the district attorney of Columbia County, New York, from 1968 to 1975.
